hothen.A: Same soft hand-painted storybook style, same round gold-rimmed medallion and same chibi proportions as the reference, but the person is now a young CONSORT (imperial concubine) of the inner palace, a graceful woman about twenty-two with a soft pretty face, black hair in a neat elegant bun with two gold hairpins, a small pearl hair ornament and one small pink flower (no crown, no phoenix), a jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with an ivory (#F1E6D2) collar and light gold embroidery at the shoulders. The medallion disc is now dusky muted mauve-pink instead of red. Her face and pose: pale sickly face, folded white cloth on her forehead, hand at her temple, eyes half closed. Light posture only: the other hand still at the bottom of the medallion just inside the gold rim; no wrist pressed dramatically to the forehead, no big gesture. Both eyes looking together. Everything kept INSIDE the round medallion, the medallion drawn a bit smaller and centred so there is empty space around it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background outside the medallion, nothing else, no text.
hothen.B: Same young consort, same soft hand-painted storybook style, same elegant black bun with two gold hairpins, small pearl ornament and small pink flower, same jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with ivory (#F1E6D2) collar, same round gold-rimmed dusky muted mauve-pink medallion as the reference. NEW: she is PRETENDING TO BE A LITTLE UNWELL and leans slightly OUT of the round medallion toward the viewer: her head and shoulders come a little forward over the gold rim, her hands overlap the gold ring; small calm gesture only, no big arms, no waving, no extra hands; one hand resting lightly at her temple under a folded white cloth on her forehead, the other hand resting on the gold rim; pale face, eyes half closed, weak little frown, peeking slyly from one eye; no wrist pressed dramatically to the forehead. Wide jade green sleeves visible. Both eyes looking together. The medallion stays round and centred, a bit smaller, with her popping slightly out of it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background, nothing else, no text.
hothen.out: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green the whole time. The young consort with the gold hairpins inside the round gold medallion pretends to feel unwell: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, one hand rises softly to her temple under the folded white cloth on her forehead, her eyes half close with a weak little frown, then she peeks slyly from one eye, the other hand rests on the rim; she comes out of the round frame only a little toward the viewer. Small calm movements only, exactly two hands, no big arms, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Smooth, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
hothen.loop: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green. The young consort with the gold hairpins leaning slightly out of the round gold medallion keeps pretending in a slow loop: she sighs weakly with half-closed eyes, touches her temple lightly, then peeks slyly from one eye and closes it again; the folded cloth stays on her forehead; then she settles back to exactly the starting pose. Small calm movements only, exactly two hands, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Slow enough to read, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
